config.language: Language for the status bar, hover summary, dashboard and diagnostic messages. Applies immediately. Command Palette titles and Settings descriptions follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (use English for unsupported languages).
extension.description: Monitor Codex output token/s in the VS Code status bar, including Remote SSH.
config.codexHome: Codex data directory on this extension host. When empty, use CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex. Supports ~/. Set the .codex directory, not its sessions subdirectory.
config.scope.all: Aggregate recent sessions on this host, including subagents.
config.scope.workspace: Only include sessions whose cwd is inside the current workspace.
config.pollIntervalMs: Interval for reading log updates and refreshing the status bar, in milliseconds.
config.scanDays: Discover logs modified within this many days; already discovered older sessions remain tracked.
config.showEstimates: Estimate generation speed from recent measured rates and prefix it with ~. When disabled, wait for new measured counts during generation.
